name: Daikin FTXS50KVM
notes: Daikin FTXS50KVM using ARC433B70 remote. DAIKIN216 protocol. Generated from physical IR captures and validated on real hardware using a SofaBaton X1S IR emitter. Modes: Cool and Heat. Temperature range: 18–30 °C. Five manual fan levels. Swing modes: Off, Vertical, Horizontal and Both.
